sections.heading: Section 1: Slope, Intercepts & Rate of Change

questions.q: A line in the $xy$-plane passes through the points $(-3, 4)$ and $(5, -8)$. What is the slope of the line?
The linear function $f$ satisfies $f(0) = 8$ and $f(4) = 20$. What is the value of $f(7)$?
questions.answer: The $y$-intercept is $8$. The slope is $m = \frac{20 - 8}{4 - 0} = 3$. Therefore, $f(x) = 3x + 8$. For $x = 7$: $f(7) = 3(7) + 8 = 29$.

questions.q: What is the $x$-intercept of the line given by $4x - 7y = 28$?
Line $L_1$ has the equation $3x + 2y = 10$. Line $L_2$ is perpendicular to line $L_1$ and passes through the point $(6, -1)$. What is the equation of line $L_2$?
questions.answer: Solve for $y$ in $L_1$: $2y = -3x + 10 \Rightarrow y = -\frac{3}{2}x + 5$. The perpendicular slope is the negative reciprocal: $m_{\perp} = \frac{2}{3}$. Using point-slope: $y - (-1) = \frac{2}{3}(x - 6) \Rightarrow y + 1 = \frac{2}{3}x - 4 \Rightarrow y = \frac{2}{3}x - 5$.

questions.q: Line $P$ has equation $y = 4x - 9$. Line $Q$ is parallel to line $P$ and passes through $(2, 3)$. What is the $y$-intercept of line $Q$?
questions.answer: Parallel lines share the same slope $m = 4$. Using point $(2, 3)$: $3 = 4(2) + b \Rightarrow 3 = 8 + b \Rightarrow b = -5$.

questions.q: In the $xy$-plane, line $k$ passes through $(1, 2)$ and $(4, 8)$. If line $m$ is perpendicular to line $k$, what is the slope of line $m$?
questions.answer: Slope of $k$: $m_k = \frac{8 - 2}{4 - 1} = \frac{6}{3} = 2$. The perpendicular slope is $m_m = -\frac{1}{2}$.

questions.q: What is the greatest integer $x$ that satisfies the inequality $5 - 3x \geq -16$?
questions.answer: Subtract $5$: $-3x \geq -21$. Divide by $-3$ and reverse inequality: $x \leq 7$. The greatest integer is $7$.
Add $3$ to all parts: $-4 \leq 2x < 14$. Divide by $2$: $-2 \leq x < 7$.

questions.q: A cell phone company charges a monthly base fee of 30 dollars plus 0.08 dollars per megabyte of data used over the plan limit. If a subscriber wants their total bill to be at most 54 dollars, what is the maximum number of additional megabytes they can use?
questions.answer: Set up the inequality: $30 + 0.08m \leq 54 \Rightarrow 0.08m \leq 24 \Rightarrow m \leq \frac{24}{0.08} = 300$ megabytes.

questions.q: Which of the following points lies in the solution set of the system $y > 2x - 1$ and $y \leq -x + 6$?
The shaded region of an inequality in the $xy$-plane lies below the solid boundary line $3x - 4y = 12$. Which inequality represents this region?
questions.answer: Solve for $y$: $-4y = -3x + 12 \Rightarrow y = \frac{3}{4}x - 3$. Region below a line means $y \leq \frac{3}{4}x - 3$.

questions.q: A farmer has at most $120$ meters of fencing to enclose a rectangular vegetable garden. If the length must be at least $40$ meters, what is the maximum possible width of the garden?
questions.answer: Perimeter: $2L + 2W \leq 120 \Rightarrow L + W \leq 60$. Since $L \geq 40$, $W \leq 60 - L \leq 60 - 40 = 20$ meters.
